new_categories.label: cargo_movement_change_monitoring_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Observation of later cargo movement, shift or settlement change is a delivered monitoring service-state distinct from the initial distribution/trim condition and from cargo securing readiness.

new_categories.label: bounded_cargo_scope_coverage_confidence
new_categories.memory: Movement-change monitoring coverage can be bounded to a hold, zone or cargo parcel without retaining exact sensor or observation locations.

new_categories.label: change_detection_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability to detect a change from an earlier cargo condition is distinct from the cargo condition itself and can degrade independently.

new_categories.label: reference_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Change-detection confidence depends on a usable prior/reference condition that can be represented separately from current observations without exact baselines or measurements.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_movement_shift_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence about cargo movement or shift can be retained without movement amounts, thresholds, angles or alarm rules.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_settlement_change_confidence
new_categories.memory: Settlement or profile-change confidence is separable from gross movement/shift confidence without retaining exact profile values or cargo-specific criteria.

new_categories.label: observation_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Observation validity can be represented separately from movement-condition judgment without exact sensor types, measurement methods or calibration data.

new_categories.label: cross_check_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate cross-check confidence can degrade separately from the primary change-detection path without retaining verification procedures.

new_categories.label: stability_strength_concern_not_movement_proof
new_categories.memory: A downstream stability or strength assurance concern is not equivalent to, and does not prove, cargo movement, shift or settlement change.

new_categories.label: movement_monitoring_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Movement-change monitoring can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to scope coverage, reference condition, change-detection availability, movement/settlement confidence, observation validity or cross-check state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition uncertainty, cargo-work restriction, stability/strength concern, terminal/receiver concern, rework or schedule effects do not prove a movement, observation or bounded-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_movement_monitoring_restoration
new_categories.memory: Reference-condition recovery, observation-path restoration, cross-check verification, downstream assurance recovery and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: static_distribution_vs_later_change_detection
useful_refinements.memory: P122 captures bounded static distribution/trim condition; P123 adds the distinct later-change observation layer.

useful_refinements.label: cargo_securing_vs_movement_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P088 cargo-securing/lashing readiness can reduce movement risk but does not establish whether movement/shift/settlement change is observable.

useful_refinements.label: structural_or_stability_effect_vs_movement_state
useful_refinements.memory: Structural or stability assurance effects are downstream and distinct from the cargo movement/change state itself.

useful_refinements.label: generic_condition_monitoring_vs_reference_change_logic
useful_refinements.memory: Prior monitoring families refine availability/validity concepts, while movement-change monitoring additionally depends on a bounded reference-condition confidence.

duplicates.label: generic_monitoring_validity_cross_check_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic monitoring availability, validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive cargo movement/shift/settlement change-monitoring orientation and source-discovery output; not cargo-shift response, redistribution, securing, stability or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact movement, threshold, alarm, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
